::: {#def-identical-relational-distributions .theorem}
## Identical relational distributions

A bipartite graph generator with local tie formation has identical relational distributions if every dyad has the same relational equation $f_{\psi,k}$ and the same error distribution:

$$
U_{k,il}\overset{d}{=}U_{k,i'l'}\qquad\text{for all } i,i'\in\mathcal{P},\ l,l'\in\mathcal{Q}.
$$
:::
